doing:
Brainlabs positions as an independent, founder led, full service media agency uniting media, measurement and creative, run against revenue and profit rather than platform metrics: it buys media for large advertisers and reports on money made rather than platform numbers. The record holds no headline claim, no partner badges, no HQ city, founding year or employee count, and its confidence reads low.

The sold mix has no lead line; seven lines score 2 and read as core. AI Search / GEO rests on AI Visibility as the first homepage service pillar, aimed at brand visibility in LLMs and search; SEO shares that pillar with digital PR and content and has its own page. Paid Search sits under Paid Media, one of four homepage pillars under a media agency H1, with Paid Social, Programmatic & CTV and Google Marketing Platform pages, and the pillar spans offline channels. Creator & Influencer rests on a Creative & Influencer pillar and a dedicated Influencer Marketing page; Data & Measurement on an Analytics & Measurement pillar naming attribution, incrementality testing and MMM. Retail media, CRO, content and PR and AI automation score 1 with no evidence note; B2B pipeline and local score 0.

Its AI posture is two claims: it pitches AI Visibility (SEO, PR and content for LLM answers) and says staff work alongside in house AI agents within its Test and Earn method, the only proprietary material on record besides the Our Agents section. The Horus P6 note cites the edition's Nilometer N36 counter case: entry level hiring up 237% from Oct 2023 to Apr 2026 while adopting AI heavily. The record lists no dated moves, news, case studies, jobs or pricing signals. Conspicuously absent for a scaled performance media agency: any office, named client or partner accreditation, a sitemap the crawler could count (0 URLs) and a headline result.

For a scaled performance media agency selling to enterprise retailers, that silence is the finding: a rival cannot name the accounts to contest from this record, and a prospect asking Brainlabs for references will get names the Radar has not seen.

What the base needs next is inferred from the sold mix, since no client signal exists. It is likely, low confidence, that such clients will ask for incrementality and MMM proof as attention prices split and for citation measurement as clicks give way to answers; Brainlabs sells both lines, but the record shows no client for whom it has done either.

openings:
